observed.caption: Indoor dining area with wooden tables and folding chairs beside a stone arch and potted plants, with a wall sign in the background.
observed.description: The photo shows an indoor commercial dining space with light-colored tiled flooring and a stone-clad arch on the right foreground holding a black metal stand with three potted green plants. Several wooden-top tables with black metal folding chairs are arranged on the floor, some near the center and left. On the left, a person in a dark jacket and light pants sits at a table with hands near the face, beneath two framed pictures of food mounted on a white pillar. The ceiling has recessed round lights and a white surface. In the background, a dark counter with two silhouetted seated figures is visible against a blue-gray wall with large dark lettering, and hanging pendant lights and an illuminated exit sign hang from the ceiling. The far background shows a darker area with an escalator and additional ceiling fixtures.
